request.providedBy: Runner-owned literal tool profile; no worker argv/root/flag/expected-diagnostic authority

worker.stdio: Parent-owned stdin closed, stdout/stderr capture pipes; no IPC endpoint in compiler-API child
worker.deadline: Minimum of enclosing wrapper absolute deadline and root global deadline; guards/capture/cleanup included; no reset

result.normalNegative: Compiler diagnostics are normal data. Exact matching plus completed capture/guards yields validation-worker exit0; no tscCLI exit0/2 is asserted.

parentRequirements: Authenticate new and prior active source closure/modes before launch; do not use mutable HEAD.
Materialize only five unchanged templates as0600 caseRoot/id.mts; token replacement is absolute POSIX .js filesystem specifiers, not file URLs.
Keep parent stdout/stderr/IPC/job metadata evidence outside the exact caseRoot input/raw/result tree; worker startup admits only request plus selected fixture.
Authenticate exact copied tool tree, full910 subject package and request hash; S must be independently built, M physically moved.
Capture actual Node-worker status/signal/timeout/overflow/stdout/stderr/timing/known reap separately from compiler diagnostics.
Every nonzero/signal/timeout/unsafe guard/capture/retirement remains aggregateFAIL. No expected-negative process waiver.
Authenticate raw/result mode/hash/membership after known reap; bind request fixture/layout/roots, strict options, sourceFiles, raw receipt and diagnostic data.
Return the exact API result only after worker exit0 and safe postguards; do not trust matched:true alone. Adapter captures and rechecks the exact predicate.
Count raw/result/IPC/terminal publications in declared capture and working budgets. Preserve partial raw evidence on overflow/failure.
Integrate/reseal before Root route; old INTERFACE/TYPES/source/evidence remain immutable history.

diagnosticSchema.locations: Actual source filename;1-based line/column; actual0-based start/length retained; null only when compiler lacks location
diagnosticSchema.category: TypeScript numeric category0/1/2/3 retained; expected primary category1
diagnosticSchema.messageChain: Original string or recursively exact messageText/code/category/next data; full flattened message retained separately
diagnosticSchema.related: All related diagnostics retained recursively; no primary diagnostic filtering
diagnosticSchema.negativePredicate: Exactly one original primary code/file/line/column/message. No extras, warnings or unresolved imports.
diagnosticSchema.relatedAllowance: T04/T05: zero or one category3 code6500 at admitted limits.d.ts3:14 or2:14, exact property span/message. Others: none.

fieldValidation: protocol.mjs exactRecord/finiteOwnData/validateResult; own-data keys and order, finite values, no holes/accessors/symbols/extras or prototype-identity shorthand
forwarding: ASSEMBLY.json: only T01..T05 replace transport; other22 IDs call unchanged prior module with same api and caseId
